anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Take on the tenth — not sacrifice on the tenth.

pass_a_gloss: He does not say: On the tenth of the month let them sacrifice a sheep, but let them take a sheep. And this sheep they are commanded to sacrifice on the fourteenth.
pass_b_english: He does not say: ["On the tenth] of the month [let them sacrifice] a sheep," but "[let them take] a sheep." And [this sheep] they are commanded [to sacrifice] on the fourteenth.
